titulo.alumno: A complaint · Shopping, returns and warranty

intro: Part 3: a complaint. Compare the two clues and distinguish what the text says from what it only seems to suggest.

texto: When reading a return policy, separate the time limit, the condition the item must be in and the proof of purchase. «Hvis» can introduce a condition; the word order of the sentence depends on whether it is a main or a subordinate clause.
Compare the two clues and distinguish what the text says from what it only seems to suggest.
